en.text:
I build software systems and AI applications that turn real-world problems into usable technical solutions.

My work spans software engineering, machine learning, computer vision, backend development, databases, and systems design. I learn by building: from financial intelligence for Kenyan SMEs to road-condition research and location-aware fleet systems.

I am a third-year Computer Science student based in Nairobi, Kenya, interested in internships, technical fellowships, research, and thoughtful engineering work.
